name: Entrata
description: Entrata is a property-management operating system for multifamily and other residential portfolios, connecting leasing, CRM, accounting, payments, maintenance, renewals, resident operations, and AI-driven workflows in one platform.
best_for: Multifamily and large property operators that want leasing, accounting, resident experience, maintenance, payments, and portfolio operations on one connected platform.
features: Leasing and CRM workflows from lead management through signed lease
Property accounting, accounts payable, budgeting, reporting, and payments
AI-assisted and agentic workflows across leasing, accounting, maintenance, renewals, and payments

tiers.name: Entrata platform
tiers.notes: Public product and demo pages direct buyers to a demo/sales process; no public numeric self-serve price was found.

pros: Connects CRM, ERP/accounting, leasing, and property operations in one system
Broad coverage of multifamily workflows including resident-facing experiences
Current platform emphasizes configurable automation and AI agents across core operations
cons: Enterprise breadth can be more complex than smaller landlords require
Evaluation starts with a demo rather than instant self-service signup

alternatives.name: AppFolio
alternatives.description: Property management software for leasing, accounting, maintenance, and resident operations.
alternatives.best_for: Property managers wanting an established all-in-one property platform.

alternatives.name: Buildium
alternatives.description: Property management platform for rental operations, accounting, leasing, and maintenance.
alternatives.best_for: Small and midsize property managers seeking a simpler property-management suite.

alternatives.name: Yardi Breeze
alternatives.description: Cloud property-management software with accounting, leasing, payments, and maintenance tools.
alternatives.best_for: Smaller portfolios wanting published per-unit entry pricing.
